title: Fourth Meeting with Salma

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: Hello again. I was hoping I would see you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hello again. I was hoping I would see you.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: I'm sorry I was rude before. It was nice to have a conversation that isn’t about ducts. Or broth.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry I was rude before. It was nice to have a conversation that isn’t about ducts. Or broth.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: It’s so nice to have a conversation that isn't about ducts. Or broth.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It’s so nice to have a conversation that isn't about ducts. Or broth.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: Yes. I've ordered so much Ramen over the years I could do it in my sleep.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. I've ordered so much Ramen over the years I could do it in my sleep.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: Oh, I work for the Bureau of Health and Sanitation, in the Pipes Division. Specializing in Ducts.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, I work for the Bureau of Health and Sanitation, in the Pipes Division. Specializing in Ducts.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: It isn’t. There are more pipes than anyone can count in this city, and almost all of them have ducts, and almost half are those ducts are broken… you get the picture.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It isn’t. There are more pipes than anyone can count in this city, and almost all of them have ducts, and almost half are those ducts are broken… you get the picture.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: I can tell you’ve never been in real trouble.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can tell you’ve never been in real trouble.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: To have a roof over my head, a place to sleep, food, safety… there were times in the past I thought I'd never see the sky again. So no, I don’t find it dull.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: To have a roof over my head, a place to sleep, food, safety… there were times in the past I thought I'd never see the sky again. So no, I don’t find it dull.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: You’re like the rest, only eyes for the Spire. But I don’t care what’s up there. Everything I ever loved was here. I won’t give up on it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You’re like the rest, only eyes for the Spire. But I don’t care what’s up there. Everything I ever loved was here. I won’t give up on it.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: No. There was a man at Steam Bones who I thought could have been him but it was just my imagination, playing tricks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. There was a man at Steam Bones who I thought could have been him but it was just my imagination, playing tricks.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: My parents were killed in a shuttle accident when I was twenty. Seth was only 15.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My parents were killed in a shuttle accident when I was twenty. Seth was only 15.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: I was so scared of that. I spent every last Lim of our parents' savings bribing LifeCorp to perform searches on unidentified corpses…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was so scared of that. I spent every last Lim of our parents' savings bribing LifeCorp to perform searches on unidentified corpses…

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: Then I borrowed instead, from as many loan sharks as I could find. And when I couldn’t pay it back… well.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then I borrowed instead, from as many loan sharks as I could find. And when I couldn’t pay it back… well.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: You ever heard of "Lims for Limbs?" I was lucky. They only took my toes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You ever heard of "Lims for Limbs?" I was lucky. They only took my toes.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: I see you’ve heard of Calhoun. He’s actually not as bad as people say. He only took my toes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I see you’ve heard of Calhoun. He’s actually not as bad as people say. He only took my toes.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: When I wear shoes, no one can tell. If the BHSPD knew, they never would have hired me. Speaking of which, I have to go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When I wear shoes, no one can tell. If the BHSPD knew, they never would have hired me. Speaking of which, I have to go.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: Thanks. I have to go now. Work calls.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks. I have to go now. Work calls.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: Spent every last Lim of our parents' savings searching for him. Hired a private investigator, bribed CorpSec...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Spent every last Lim of our parents' savings searching for him. Hired a private investigator, bribed CorpSec...

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: You would? That's very kind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You would? That's very kind.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: It was. Thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was. Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: He had a temper. But he was funny. A sweet kid underneath it all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He had a temper. But he was funny. A sweet kid underneath it all.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: This isn't a game.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This isn't a game.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: I tried to look after him, but he fell in with a bad crowd. We argued one night, he stormed out and that was the last time I ever saw I him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I tried to look after him, but he fell in with a bad crowd. We argued one night, he stormed out and that was the last time I ever saw I him.

nodes.speaker: Salma Smith
nodes.text: I didn’t stop, not even when the money was gone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn’t stop, not even when the money was gone.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I’m glad to see you too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m glad to see you too.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I’m glad to see you too.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I’m glad to see you too.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ducts?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ducts?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Broth?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Broth?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds fascinating...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds fascinating...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Don't you find it dull?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't you find it dull?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry, I didn’t mean to offend you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry, I didn’t mean to offend you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sorry, I didn’t mean to offend you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sorry, I didn’t mean to offend you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Any sign of your brother?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Any sign of your brother?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you know why he went missing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know why he went missing?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you know why he went missing?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you know why he went missing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What did you do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What did you do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like he's dead.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like he's dead.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And then?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Lims for Limbs?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lims for Limbs?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well WHAT?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well WHAT?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That’s terrible.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That’s terrible.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess that's fair.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess that's fair.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, I wish you luck.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I wish you luck.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So how did you get into trouble?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So how did you get into trouble?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So how did you get into trouble?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So how did you get into trouble?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: See you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: See you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If you want, I can help look for your brother...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you want, I can help look for your brother...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If you want, I can help look for your brother...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If you want, I can help look for your brother...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It was good to talk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was good to talk.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is there anything else you remember about him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is there anything else you remember about him?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Is there anything else you remember about him?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Is there anything else you remember about him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll keep an eye out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll keep an eye out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Bye.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bye.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have been in more than you might think.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have been in more than you might think.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have been in more than you might think.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have been in more than you might think.
